asset.name: BottomSheet
asset.description: The mobile-first drawer with snap points, drag handle, keyboard avoidance, scroll handoff between sheet and content, velocity-aware settling, and accessible non-gesture controls.

requires.reason: Presentation, focus, and dismissal lifecycle are shared.

signatureMoment.description: Dragging the sheet tracks the finger exactly and releases into the nearest snap point at a speed that matches the throw, so the surface feels attached to the gesture rather than animated after it.
